items.title: Oliver Twist
items.description: Follow Oliver's adventure chapter by chapter — watch each chapter video inside the site.

sections.title: Games
sections.description: Browser games for warm-ups, icebreakers, and first-day fun.

items.title: Oliver Twist Adventure
items.description: A Victorian adventure map for Chapters 10 & 11 — 12 stages, 12 different mini-games, a storybook to collect and a certificate at the end.

items.title: 5 Seconds Challenge
items.description: Fast-paced game-show style rounds across 7 levels — letters, memory, acting, and brain teasers, all against a 5-second timer.

items.title: Mystery Box Game
items.description: 25 mystery boxes, each hiding a fun icebreaker question or dare — great for getting students talking on day one.

items.title: Mystery Picture
items.description: Reveal a hidden picture tile by tile, use clues, and guess what it is — three difficulty levels plus a teacher mode.

items.title: Might or Could? Detective Game
items.description: 12 detective mysteries to practise might, could and might not for possibilities — with happy background music and a score at the end.

items.title: Passive Voice Quest
items.description: Present simple active → passive, step by step: classify the sentence, flip it, then add be + PP and by. 36 colourful examples across 4 levels.
